attributes.description: SRE monitoring dashboard for OVH Managed Kubernetes individual nodes. Covers node status, version currency, pool membership, cloud instance details, deployment timelines, and per-node breakdowns.

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.node-*
| STATS `Distinct Node Count` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.kubernetes.node.id)

| STATS `Distinct Node Count` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ovh.kubernetes.node.id)

| WHERE ovh.kubernetes.node.is_up_to_date == true
| STATS `Count of nodes` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.node-*

FROM logs-ovh_managed_kubernetes.node-*
| STATS `Total Node Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Node Status` = ovh.kubernetes.node.status
